description: Schema vectors of libre-ai.produit.v1. Each invalid vector is the first valid one with one change: `set` writes a value at a path, `unset` removes the key at a path. `expect` is a fragment of the schema error. The rules that need another source (catalogue, inventory, other fiches, the count of etiquettes, the names of a_relire) are not schema rules: they are exercised in ecosystem/produits.test.ts.

valid.name: a product with a working name and no carrier

value.promesse: Garder ses notes sur son poste, lisibles sans l'outil.
value.pour_qui: une personne qui prend des notes
value.a_la_place_de: votre application de notes en ligne par abonnement
capacites: Écrire, relier et retrouver des notes.
ne_fait_pas: Publier une note sans action explicite.

valid.name: a product with a public name, a carrier and dependencies

value.promesse: Suivre des sources et lire hors ligne ce qu'on a conservé.
value.pour_qui: une personne ou une organisation qui suit des sources
value.a_la_place_de: votre lecteur de flux en ligne par abonnement

invalid.name: a field the schema does not declare
invalid.because: the schema is closed: a state, a charter or a source list does not enter a fiche

invalid.name: a draft field carried over
invalid.because: sources, inferences and contradictions stay in the drafts

invalid.name: the draft schema version
invalid.because: a draft is not a published fiche

invalid.name: an identifier of another form
invalid.because: a product is Pnn, as the catalogue writes it

invalid.name: a missing field
invalid.because: every field is required: an absence is written null or as an empty list, never left out

invalid.name: a missing carrier field
invalid.because: « no carrier » is written null, so that it is a statement and not an omission

invalid.name: a category outside the eight domains
invalid.because: the categories are the domains of ADR-0042 §1
invalid.expect: /categorie: must be equal to one of the allowed values

invalid.name: a realisation outside the enumeration
invalid.because: the forms of realisation are a closed list
invalid.expect: /realisation: must be equal to one of the allowed values

invalid.name: a carrier outside the organisation
invalid.because: a carrier is a repository of the organisation, written owner/name

invalid.name: an empty carrier
invalid.because: no carrier is null, not an empty string

invalid.name: a dependency that is not a product identifier
invalid.because: depend_de links products, not bricks or repositories

invalid.name: no capacity
invalid.because: a fiche says what the product does
invalid.expect: /capacites: must NOT have fewer than 1 items

invalid.name: no limit
invalid.because: a fiche says what the product does not do
invalid.expect: /ne_fait_pas: must NOT have fewer than 1 items

invalid.name: a promise with a line break
invalid.because: a value printed by the gate must not forge a line of its output

set.value:
Garder ses notes.
Product catalogue verified

invalid.name: a list where a text is expected
a name that is neither a text nor null
invalid.because: a name is a text, or null
invalid.expect: /nom_public: must match exactly one schema in oneOf

invalid.name: an etiquette that is not a text
invalid.because: an etiquette is a short label

invalid.name: a_relire that is not a field name
invalid.because: a_relire lists field names, not sentences
